verses.text: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! Everything in me, praise his holy name!
Praise the LORD, my soul. Don’t forget a single good thing he’s done for you.
He forgives every sin and heals every disease.
He buys your life back from ruin and crowns you with faithful love and tender mercy.
He fills your life with good things so your youth comes back like an eagle’s.
The LORD does what’s right and brings justice to everyone who’s oppressed.
He showed Moses how he works and let the people of Israel see what he did.
The LORD is full of mercy and grace. He’s slow to anger and overflowing with faithful love.
He won’t keep accusing us or hold on to his anger forever.
He hasn’t treated us as our sins deserve or paid us back for what we’ve done wrong.
As high as the heavens are above the earth, that’s how great his faithful love is for those who fear him.
As far as east is from west, that’s how far he’s taken our wrongs away from us.
Like a father who feels for his children, the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.
He knows how we’re made. He remembers we’re dust.
Our days are like grass. We bloom like flowers in a field.
The wind blows over a flower and it’s gone. Even the spot where it grew forgets it.
But the LORD’s faithful love goes from forever to forever for those who fear him. His righteousness reaches their children’s children,
those who keep his covenant and remember to follow his instructions.
The LORD set up his throne in heaven, and his kingdom rules over everything.
Praise the LORD, you mighty angels who carry out what he says and obey his voice.
Praise the LORD, all his armies, all you servants who do what pleases him.
Praise the LORD, everything he’s made, everywhere he rules. Praise the LORD, my soul!
